name: lathe
description: A software factory for Claude Code: a working agreement with enforced gates, a code graph and evidence ledger, an epic writer, and an umbrella that onboards a brownfield repository.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Contract, tests, implement, verify, ship, with hooks that enforce scope, secrets, route auth, module state, test quality and verify-before-commit as a ratchet over today's debt. Python, Node/TypeScript, Go and Rust adapters.

plugins.name: graph
plugins.description: Code graph derived per commit, an evidence-gated intent ledger and impact-ordered verification, served over MCP with Agent-spawn model-routing hooks and an orchestrator. Needs uv and a Postgres.

plugins.name: epic-writer
plugins.description: Write, break down and review epics, features and user stories with outcome-first hypotheses, INVEST stories and Given/When/Then criteria.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: Thin umbrella: /factory:init onboards a brownfield repository, /factory:assess measures maturity and security, /factory:ticket and /factory:feature drive a ticket. Needs sdlc and graph from this marketplace.
